headline: Easy + strides done as prescribed — solid shakeout before the move to Podgorica
summary:
35min easy ran at 149bpm avg (target 138-148, so a touch hot but trivial) plus the 6x20s strides block, 43 min total, RPE 4/feel 3. HR drifted into the 150s/160s zone briefly during strides as expected — no ITB or pain flagged. This was pure sharpening volume two days before travel, and it did its job without adding fatigue: load logged 43 against plan's 40, basically exact. One thing to note for context, not action — today's wellness reading (HRV 54, down from 63-66 the prior three days, RHR 50 vs the recent 44-46 floor, sleep only 5h50) would have been AMBER on a pre-session gate-check, but the prescribed session was deliberately light, so it was a non-issue in practice.</summary>
